title: Shopify Plus Commerce Engineering
subtitle: Liquid, Online Store 2.0, Functions, B2B wholesale & Point of Sale
description:
A six-chapter, thirty-lesson path from "I can build a website" to "I am the internal owner of a Shopify Plus storefront, a B2B wholesale catalog, and a multi-location POS deployment."

This course assumes you already know HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Git, and that you have shipped and deployed real sites. It does **not** re-teach web development. It teaches the platform: **Liquid** and Online Store 2.0 theme architecture, the Ajax and Section Rendering APIs, Admin and Storefront **GraphQL**, **Shopify Functions**, checkout extensibility, **Flow** and **Launchpad**, the **B2B** company/catalog/price-list model, and **POS UI extensions** built to be replicated across a growing retail footprint.

Every chapter ends with a test, and the course ends with a final exam. A single storefront project — a workwear brand running DTC, wholesale and retail on one Plus organization — is built across all thirty lessons.
